name: Turkey (TBDY 2018, TS 500, TS 498)
description: The Turkish codes (alpha 9 track C21), a pack that extends the US pack aci318-asce7-22. Seismic: TBDY 2018 (the design earthquake DD-2 from the site's SS and S1, entered from the AFAD hazard map or a city's example values; the local site classes ZA-ZF with FS and F1 of Tablo 2.1 and 2.2; the horizontal elastic spectrum with TA, TB, TL = 6 s; BKS 1-3 with I = 1.5, 1.2, 1.0; DTS 1-4 by SDS (SAEngine's categories D, C, B); R and D by system of Tablo 4.1 with Ra(T) = D + (R/I - D) T/TB below TB; the equivalent lateral load with ΔFN = 0.0075 N Vt, Vt ≥ 0.04 I SDS W, TpA = Ct HN^(3/4); the modal analysis with γE = 0.80; the drift λ δ/h ≤ 0.008 κ or 0.016 κ; the building height classes BYS 1-8 and, for BYS 1 tall buildings, the performance-based design requirement reported with the procedures (the Pushover analysis with the DD-2 and DD-1 hazard levels, the Nonlinear time history analysis with 11 records)). Loads: TS 500 / TBDY 4.4.4 combinations. Concrete: TS 500:2000 limit state design (γmc 1.5, γms 1.15, fcd, fctd, k1, the shear Vcr / Vc, punching, minimum steel) and TBDY 2018 Bolum 7 ductile detailing (strong column 1.2, confinement, joints); bars Ø8-Ø32 (TS 708). Steel: the base pack's AISC 360-22 and AISC 341-22 (the Turkish steel regulation of 2016 follows AISC 360). Not covered (the base pack's, named so in the report): TS 498 live loads and wind (the wind speed is a placeholder), the TBDY strain limits of Bolum 5, the second order limit of TBDY 4.9.2, the other TS 500 areas. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the cities' SS and S1 are example readings to be replaced by the site's AFAD values.
